info.title: NTL Spectral Style Heads - Paired 4404
info.subtitle: Fourier, PCA and kernel heads for the 0.639 and 0.637 submissions
info.description:
Trained readout heads for the Name That LLM paired experiment: 0.639 with 4,404 additional synthetic passages versus 0.637 for the official-only control (public baseline 0.636).

Files: official_only.joblib, synthetic4404.joblib, readouts.py and COMPLETE.json. These are full-fit classifier banks, not fold adapters. Both use all 2,699 official training rows; only the augmented bank uses our 4,404 synthetic training passages. No raw passages, test predictions, training feature matrices or LoRA backbone weights are included.

The heads combine late-layer Fourier features, PCA Fourier features, word/character prompt residuals, Laplace, kNN and RBF readouts. They reuse the exact public LoRA24 checkpoint features. The public LoRA adapters are unchanged. COMPLETE.json records label order, training provenance and file hashes.

Based on fleongg/ntl-part-two-complement, scored V1 361351359, with upstream model and method credits retained in the accompanying notebooks.

Augmented inference: https://www.kaggle.com/code/kirilltym/teach-more-spectral-signature-4404-texts
Official-only control: https://www.kaggle.com/code/kirilltym/remove-the-prompt-spectral-style-ensemble
